text.text:
*Goal*
Migrate the monolithic Rust backend into an RPBI-style service architecture: reusable `packages/` Cargo workspace crates + thin `backend/` services talking over RabbitMQ + a Python gateway the frontend calls.

*Decisions confirmed*
• Package language: *Rust* (Cargo workspace)
• Gateway: *Python* (FastAPI) — full auth + reverse-proxy + WS proxy
• Persistence: *PostgreSQL* + *MongoDB* + *Redis* (cache)
• Broker: *RabbitMQ* (topic exchanges, dead-letter exchanges, transactional outbox)
• Strategy: *Full rewrite alongside current app* on `refactor/*` branch
• `master` branch untouched until parity is reached.

```
Document-editor/
├── packages/                         # Cargo workspace (reusable)
│   ├── domain/                       # entities, value objects, errors
│   ├── contracts/                    # EventMessage<T>, Topics, event payloads
│   ├── messaging-rabbitmq/           # lapin wrapper + outbox relay
│   ├── persistence-postgres/         # sqlx + outbox table
│   ├── persistence-mongo/            # mongodb driver wrapper
│   ├── cache/                        # deadpool-redis
│   ├── auth/                         # JWT / CurrentUser
│   ├── observability/                # tracing + OTLP
│   └── errors/                       # unified AppError
│
├── backend/                          # Cargo workspace (services)
│   ├── room-service/                 # whiteboards + WS
│   ├── doc-service/                  # documents + WS (CRDT)
│   └── latex-service/                # pdflatex + DOCX
│
├── gateway/                          # Python FastAPI
│   ├── app/{routers,adapters,middleware,security,proxy}/
│   ├── tests/
│   └── Dockerfile
│
├── infra/
│   ├── docker-compose.yml            # postgres, mongo, redis, rabbitmq, services, gateway
│   └── docker/{Dockerfile.rust-service,Dockerfile.gateway,rabbit/}
│
├── frontend/                         # unchanged; proxy target = gateway
└── Cargo.toml                        # root umbrella workspace
```
